text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-queue-backlog_high at 4332100001 — queue_depth=7.8k, p95_latency=920ms, autoscaler_lag_seconds=210. Autoscaler status: reconciling but failing to provision due to quota+rate-limit.

pagerduty: PagerDuty notice — inference-queue-backlog_high triggered. Escalation: auto-escalate in 6m if not acknowledged.

jess (oncall): Acked 4332100003. I'm on it. Any immediate customer impacts?

lee (eng): Telemetry shows spike in 503s and throttled connections from inference pool. Controller logs show repeated "InsufficientInstanceCapacity" and provider 429s on VM create. Also seeing frequent spot eviction events for the inference pool.

noah (sre): I can flip pool preference to on-demand and kick a manual scale. That should drain queue faster. If control-plane API is rate-limited we'll need to slow down autoscaler's churn.

clara (product): Early hit: two paying customers (gamma-corp, searchstudio) report increased latency; gamma-corp saw retries bump their tail latencies. CS alerted and monitoring list created.

lee (eng): Autoscaler controller excerpt:
```
E 4332100006 scale_controller.go: failed to create instance: error=QuotaExceeded: limit for CPUs per region reached
W 4332100007 retrying in 5s (attempt 8)
```
Also kube events: many pods Pending due to no nodes with required labels.

ops-bot: Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/autoscaler-queue-drain — manual mitigations listed: prefer-on-demand, temporary scale, route-fallback.

jess (oncall): Performing quick manual actions: 1) scale worker deployment, 2) set on-demand preference, 3) apply temporary routing fallback. Executing: 
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/inference-worker --replicas=80
infra/spotctl set-preference --pool inference --mode on-demand
redwoodctl routing set-fallback --path /v1/generate --model model-slim-a --pct 40
```

noah (sre): I'm launching 10 on-demand nodes now. Note: provider API 429s; I'll throttle the requests to avoid cascading failures.

incident-bot: :information_source: PagerDuty acknowledged by jess at 4332100003 — escalation timer paused.

lee (eng): After on-demand spin-up, some nodes started but 4 failed with kubelet startup crashloop; logs point to cert rotation race at join. Restarting the join daemonset job.

jess (oncall): Routing fallback applied. Reducing pressure on large-model routes.

ops-bot: Queue depth snapshots: 7800 -> 5100 (after 3m) -> 2700 (after 7m) -> 900 (after 14m).

clara (product): Customer-impact update: gamma-corp saw errors drop after fallback; informing account manager. No data corruption, just request failures and retries.

noah (sre): Manual nodes stable now. One node had out-of-memory on init, cordoned and recycled.

lee (eng): Autoscaler controller returning to healthy reconcile at 4332100046. Changed config: temporarily increased API backoff and lowered create-rate. We'll keep aggressive downscale disabled.

jess (oncall): Handoff/next steps: I'll monitor for another 30m then hand to lee. Follow-ups: INF-5001 investigate node join cert race, INF-5002 autoscaler kubeapi backoff tuning, INF-5003 quota strategy for high QPS bursts.

ops-bot: Created incident tickets: INF-5001, INF-5002, INF-5003. Runbook recommends postmortem within 48h.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Temporary mitigation complete — queue draining and autoscaler stable. Marking PD incident as mitigated/acknowledged.

pagerduty: If no regression in 60m, suggest auto-close.

jess (oncall): Final check — queue ~300 at 4332100060, p95 latency back near baseline. Moving to monitoring-only. If any regression, reopen PD. :thumbsup:

clara (product): Thanks all. I'll draft a short customer note and schedule the post-incident review.

ops-bot: Thread will be archived when closed.
